## Definition of done

- [ ] Change is scoped to this task only
- [ ] SKILL.md ≤200 lines if touching a skill
- [ ] `agentskills validate` passes (if skill changed)
- [ ] PR uses intent-separated commits (`pr-authoring`)

## How to start

1. Fork + branch `feature/<slug>`
2. Run `bash install.sh` if skills not installed
3. Try `quickstart` skill for a feel of the library
4. Read `CONTRIBUTING.md`
